audit.why: Lane is correctly framed as skill/even (Skill on 5 of 7 rows) — Hwei is a fragile, dash-less poke mage who dies to a clean Q+E burst, but his kit denies Blitzcrank's walk-up once it is loaded.

audit.whatIsWrong: Power spikes reference a nonexistent Hwei ability 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)' repeatedly instead of the real E, Subject: Torment.
audit.why: Hwei's kit (per enemyKit) has P Signature of the Visionary, Q Subject: Disaster, W Subject: Serenity, E Subject: Torment, R Spiraling Despair. There is no 'Subject: Fear' spell.
audit.corrected: Replaced every occurrence with Subject: Torment (E), the ability that actually houses his CC, and added its real 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names a fake ability and has no digit; two Do's/Don'ts bullets paste the tradeGood/tradeBad line under an unrelated title (lintFindings).
audit.why: Q Rocket Grab (20-16s) and R Static Field (60/40/20s) are both blockable/countered by his projectile-block flags; his E Subject: Torment is the real CC to track, on a 12-10s cooldown.
audit.corrected: Rewrote breakdown.cooldowns with real numbers; rewrote dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d to match their own titles instead of repeating tradeGood/tradeBad.

edits.before: Pay the rent and hook the foreclosure. Track Subject: Fear (CC Paints) before every commit and keep the lane where your duo’s pattern works.
edits.after: Pay the rent and hook the foreclosure. Track Subject: Torment (E) before every commit and keep the lane where your duo’s pattern works.

edits.before: Hwei wins by landing Subject: Fear (CC Paints), denying your pattern, and billing your duo per wave until the all-in is unaffordable.
edits.after: Hwei wins by landing Subject: Torment (E), denying your pattern, and billing your duo per wave until the all-in is unaffordable.

edits.before: - Blitzcrank vs Hwei - Track: Hwei Subject: Fear (CC Paints). - Engage when their answer is down — the chain only needs one clean start. - Engage only on Subject: Fear (CC Paints)’s cooldown. - Spend your ultimate on fight windows only.
edits.after: - Blitzcrank vs Hwei - Track: Hwei Subject: Torment (E). - Engage when their answer is down — the chain only needs one clean start. - Engage only on Subject: Torment (E)’s cooldown. - Spend your ultimate on fight windows only.

edits.before: - Hwei Subject: Fear (CC Paints): matchup-defining — All his CC lives on E — dodge the paint and the burst never chains. It writes your spacing rules. - W Overdrive is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
edits.after: - Subject: Torment (E) carries his CC: 12s at rank 1, 10s by rank 5 - hook once it's spent. - Overdrive (W) is a 15s disengage tool, not for trades. - Static Field (R) resets at 60/40/20s, silencing on the second cast - save it for the all-in.

edits.before: If Hwei’s duo gets a kill, respect Subject: Fear (CC Paints) and reset to vision work. Two kills: peel only — peel only and rebuild through vision and engage discipline.
edits.after: If Hwei’s duo gets a kill, respect Subject: Torment (E) and reset to vision work. Two kills: peel only — peel only and rebuild through vision and engage discipline.

edits.before: Track Hwei’s Subject: Fear (CC Paints): All his CC lives on E — dodge the paint and the burst never chains. Forward steps wait for its downtime.
edits.after: Track Hwei’s Subject: Torment (E): all his CC lives there, on a 12-10s cooldown — dodge the paint and the burst never chains. Forward steps wait for its downtime.

edits.before: Commit on Subject: Fear (CC Paints)’s cooldown, on your first item spike, and with your carry’s damage online. Bait the answer, then sign.
edits.after: Commit on Subject: Torment (E)’s cooldown, on your first item spike, and with your carry’s damage online. Bait the answer, then sign.

edits.before: Bait the answer, start the chain, and let your carry collect — engage trades are all-or-nothing; pick the all.
edits.after: Stay on the far side of the wave and let Subject: Disaster's spells hit minions, not you, while you wait to walk up.

edits.before: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with intentions.
edits.after: Grabbing him into a loaded Subject: Torment trades your hook for his root and silence combo instead.
